# MUTJAH (مُتَّجَه)

> MUTJAH is an execution-led digital solutions company working with companies and individuals. We build websites, digital products and platforms, internal business systems, workflow automation and applied AI — Arabic-first (native RTL) with credible English. Remote-first.
> مُتَّجَه شركة حلول رقمية تنفيذية، نعمل مع الشركات والأفراد: مواقع، منتجات ومنصات رقمية، أنظمة أعمال، أتمتة، وحلول ذكاء اصطناعي تطبيقية — بالعربية أولًا وبإنجليزية موثوقة.

## Pages
- [Arabic home / الصفحة الرئيسية](https://mutjah.com/ar): services, process, work, FAQ and contact form in Arabic
- [English home](https://mutjah.com/en): the same content in English

## What we do
- Websites & digital presence: corporate and service sites, personal sites and portfolios, landing pages, bilingual RTL/LTR sites
- Digital products & platforms: MVPs, web apps, learning/membership/booking platforms, customer portals
- Business systems & internal tools: dashboards, workflows, approvals, internal search and reporting
- Automation & applied AI: workflow automation, knowledge assistants, chatbots connected to approved knowledge, with human approval points
- Post-launch support: maintenance and improvement under a defined scope

## Common questions
- Who do you work with? Both companies and individuals (founders and professionals).
- Do you sell packages? No. Services are independent and combinable; the shape follows the need.
- How long and how much? It depends on scope; after a clarification session we return with a realistic scope and timeline.
- Do we own what you build? Yes. Handover, documentation and full ownership are included.
- What is applied AI? AI used for one defined job (for example answering from approved documents) with human-approval points, not a decorative feature.

## How we work
Clarify → Shape → Build → Launch → Support. Services are modular (no forced packages). Scope is written down before execution starts.

## Selected work
- Infeworks — bilingual B2B/B2G engineering credibility platform (live): https://infeworks.com
- Hemma (همّة) — Arabic-first Qudurat learning platform with an AI study assistant
- QIDR (قِدر) — bilingual, branch-aware restaurant menu and operations platform
- El Morabbi (المربي) — Arabic mentorship and daily-accountability platform (MVP)
- Performance Gym — membership platform with WhatsApp sales handoff (MVP)

## Why we exist
We are called MUTJAH because we believe every person and every business has a direction. What drives us is a love of helping people — companies and individuals — know where they are heading and get there with something that actually works.

## Principles
Direction before production; useful over impressive; built to be used; evidence over hype (no invented metrics, clients or testimonials); modular, not packaged.
